trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned containing duplicates and irrelevant documents. The core documents (Mahek Chahal, Neetho, Sachein) needed to verify the claim were successfully retrieved in all three hops.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved the claim verbatim and found all necessary documents (Mahek Chahal, Neetho, Sachein). The summarizer correctly identified that all claim components were verified. Hop 2 query was redundant (re-asking already-answered questions) but retrieved the same core documents again. Hop 3 query used a simple keyword list and retrieved core documents plus several irrelevant ones. The final output contains 24 documents with duplicates and irrelevant entries, which is the specified behavior of this pipeline (no deduplication or relevance filtering). All three hops completed as required, and the necessary evidence documents were present in the output.
